business_summary: Hunan Heshun Petroleum Co.,Ltd. engages in the wholesale and retail of gasoline and diesel in China. It is also involved in the gas station and convenience store operation, refined oil storage, refined oil logistics and distribution activities, charging station charging, warehousing leasing, and logistics and transportation services, as well as investment and construction of gas stations and oil depots. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Changsha, China.
business_summary_ko: 후난허순석유유한회사 중국 내 휘발유 및 경유 도매 및 소매업을 영위하고 있습니다. 또한 주유소 및 편의점 운영, 정제유 저장, 정제유 물류 및 유통 활동, 충전소 충전, 창고 임대, 물류 및 운송 서비스뿐만 아니라 주유소 및 석유 저장소에 대한 투자 및 건설에도 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 2005년에 설립되었으며 중국 창사에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
